title: POLICY & PROCEDURE PLAN FOR FIRE AND NON-FIRE EMERGENCIES
html:
Procedure for Disposal of Expired Drugs

CONTENTS

Topics
Procedure for disposal of expired drugs

Purpose

To establish a procedure for the segregation and disposal of expired drugs in hospital.

Scope

All activities required for disposal of expired drugs in the hospital.

Responsibility

      • Officer in-charge
      • Pharmacist in-charge
      • Officer in-charge Pharmacy
      • Officer in-charge of Unit/ward
      • Officer in-charge Bio-Medical Waste Management of Hospital

Procedure

All the expired drugs from various areas/departments should be returned to pharmacy of the hospital with proper documentation.

The information about expired medicines must be recorded in a separate register for expired drugs. The following particulars are to be documented:

  • Name of drug (Generic/brand)
  • Formulation (Tablet/Capsule/Syrup/ Ointment/Injection etc.)
  • Strength
  • Batch number
  • Expiry date
  • Total quantity
  • Name of the department
  • At the pharmacy the expired drugs must be received by the Pharmacist in-charge. He must verify the details and the drugs record.
  • All expired drugs should be stored preferably in a separate room ear marked for the purpose. In the absence of a separate room the expired drugs may be stored in a separate cupboard. The cupboard must always be under lock and key with a sign board on it stating “Expired drugs not for use’’. The room / cupboard must be under supervision of Officer in- charge/ Pharmacist in-charge.
  • The Officer in-charge pharmacy will inform the administrator about the details of the expired drugs for their disposal.
  • After approval from administrator will inform the Head of Institute/ Medical superintendent, about the list of expired drugs to be sent for disposal to Bio- Medical Waste In-charge.
  • The Officer in-charge will send this list to hospital Bio-Medical Waste in-charge for disposal as per rules.
  • All the expired drugs must be transported in pilfer proof containers/boxes properly labeled and sealed in accordance with prevailing Bio-Medical Waste Management Rules.
  • The hospital committee will regularly meet and assess the list of expired drugs and reasons for the same

Records

  • Expiry drug register in wards/ departments.
  • Expiry drug register in Pharmacy
  • Drug disposal register at Bio-Medical Waste Management Department.

Process Efficiency Criteria

      • The number of expired drugs in a hospital should ideally be nil or minimal.
      • Within a hospital the number of expired drugs annually must decrease over time.

Activity

Review of expired drugs by administrator at regular interval (at least annually)
